fields.label: What
fields.description: What is being grown. An account is measured by its balance; the share portfolio by what the holdings are worth; the bond portfolio by carrying value, which for amortised cost is what you paid drifting to par.

fields.label: Account
fields.description: Any account — savings, investment, anything whose balance should climb.

fields.label: Amount Each Time
fields.description: Per period, not per month. The fieldname still says monthly for compatibility; everything that needs a month's worth asks _month_equivalent rather than reading this directly.

fields.label: How Often
fields.description: How often the amount must go in. A working-day target of 50,000 is roughly 1.1m a month; the dashboard shows the month's worth and the row shows the rhythm.

fields.label: Starting Month
fields.description: YYYY-MM. The first month the target applies.

fields.label: Starting On
fields.description: Set for weekly and working-day targets. Monthly targets use the first of the starting month.

fields.label: Opening Balance
fields.description: What it was worth at the start of that month. Stored rather than recomputed, so a later correction to old transactions cannot silently move the goalposts.
